lean.statement:
theorem integral_quadraticVariationError_sq
    (hB : IsPreBrownianReal B mu)
    {n : ℕ} {times : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ≥0}
    (hmono : Monotone times) :
    ∫ omega, (quadraticVariationError B times omega) ^ 2 ∂mu =
      2 * ∑ i : Fin n,
        (((times i.succ - times i.castSucc : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) ^ 2)
approved_definition_context: Omega is a measurable space, mu is a measure on Omega, and B maps nonnegative real times to real-valued random variables.
IsPreBrownianReal B mu supplies centered Gaussian increments with variance equal to elapsed time and independence over ordered deterministic grids.
quadraticVariationError B times omega is the finite sum over i : Fin n of (B(times i.succ)-B(times i.castSucc))^2 minus the corresponding elapsed time.
Monotone times permits repeated grid points; subtraction of nonnegative reals is truncated subtraction, which equals elapsed time on ordered cells.
